Destructive.description: The `[destructive]` table of `guards.toml`: limits on destructive shell commands.

ban.description:
Command patterns that are always denied, for example `git push --force*`. `*` matches any
run of characters.

max_files_deleted_outside_claims.description: How many files a command may delete outside the seat's claims. `0` denies any such delete.

max_files_deleted_per_command.description: How many files one command may delete before the human is asked.

SpecVersion.description:
The `spec` field of a document: the version of the ACS spec it was written against.

The only supported value is `"acs/0.1"`. Readers MUST reject any other value.

description:
`.acs/policy/guards.toml`: sealed paths, protected branches and destructive-command limits.
Every field defaults to empty; the built-in default guards are applied by the policy loader.

protect_outside_repo.description:
Ask before an agent writes or deletes outside the repository (`path_escapes_repo`).
Off by default: ACS guards the repository. Targets that cannot be resolved, and targets
outside that link back into the repository, are asked about either way; protected
locations such as `ACS_HOME` are always denied.

protected_branches.description: Branch name globs on which history rewrites and force pushes are denied.

sealed.description: Globs of paths agents may never write. See [`DEFAULT_SEALED`].

spec.description: Optional spec version. If present it must be `acs/0.1`.

title: Guards
